convert_caffe2_to_torchvision_resnet: convert a Caffe2 ResNet-50 pickled model to a PyTorch TorchVision compatible state dict
convert_bgr2rgb_conv1_weights: convert BGR channel order to RGB order for the conv1 weight tensor in a Caffe2 ResNet state dict
rename_caffe2_resnet_weights: rename Caffe2 ResNet weight keys to TorchVision-compatible naming conventions
process_jigsaw_model_weights: filter and rename jigsaw pretext model blobs by removing suffix variants and keeping s0 keys
load_caffe2_pickled_weights: load a Caffe2 pickled model file and extract the blobs dictionary for weight conversion
